description: This Java source file defines an abstract class providing helper methods for mapping Adaptable objects to policy-related commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for extracting policy IDs, policies, policy entries, resources, subjects, and related components from Adaptable instances and message paths.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing static helper methods for mapping Adaptable objects to policy commands, including extracting policy IDs, policies, resources, subjects, and related components.

methods.name: policyIdFromTopicPath
methods.description: Extracts a PolicyId from a given TopicPath by using its namespace and ID.

methods.name: policyFrom
methods.description: Creates a Policy object from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: policyEntryFrom
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntry object from an Adaptable's payload, including its label.

methods.name: policyEntriesFrom
methods.description: Creates an iterable of PolicyEntry objects from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: resourceFrom
methods.description: Creates a Resource object from an Adaptable, using its payload and resource key from path.

methods.name: resourcesFrom
methods.description: Creates Resources from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: labelFrom
methods.description: Extracts a Label from an Adaptable's message path.

methods.name: entryResourceKeyFromPath
methods.description: Extracts a ResourceKey from a MessagePath, expecting a specific path structure.

methods.name: entrySubjectIdFromPath
methods.description: Extracts a SubjectId from a MessagePath, expecting a specific path structure.

methods.name: subjectFrom
methods.description: Creates a Subject from an Adaptable, using its payload and subject ID from path.

methods.name: subjectsFrom
methods.description: Creates Subjects from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: getValueFromPayload
methods.description: Private helper method to extract a non-null JsonObject value from an Adaptable's payload.
